effect-lose: You feel the effects of the {0} dissipate
boat-block: You cannot recall while mounted on a vessel
mount-block: You cannot recall while mounted on an animal
reshape-block: You already have the ability to reopen character customisation by typing .charsel
effect-size-at-max: You cannot grow any further with this effect
effect-size-at-min: You cannot shrink any further with this effect
effect-gain: You feel the effects of the {0}
coating-not-allowed: This cannot be used for coating
coating-max-charges: This weapon's coating is already at maximum charges
coating-conflict: This weapon is already coated with something else
heldhelp-coat: Hold in off hand to coat weapon or arrows
hotkey-style-hud: Toggle effect hud style (icon row / compact)
MinPlayerHeight-Comment: Hard floor for any effect that shrinks a player, in blocks. No effect can shrink a player below this, even if its own settings ask for less.
MaxPlayerHeight-Comment: Hard ceiling for any effect that grows a player, in blocks. No effect can grow a player past this, even if its own settings ask for more.
CoatableWeaponTags-Comment: Comma-separated VS item tags for weapons that can be coated with effects. "weapon-melee" is the default, meaning every vanilla weapon and every modded weapon with that tag can be coated. Replace it with something like "weapon-sword, tool-cleaver" to only allow specific tags. Requires valid tags to work.
CoatableProjectilesCodes-Comment: Comma-separated wildcard item codes for projectiles that can be coated with effects. "*arrow*" is the default, matching every vanilla and modded arrow. Patterns are matched against the full item code (domain:path), e.g. "game:arrow-*, mymod:bolt-*". Leave empty to disable projectile coating entirely.
AllowFly-Comment: Globally allows or blocks any effect that grants flight, regardless of what the effect's own JSON asks for.
AllowClimb-Comment: Globally allows or blocks any effect that grants climb-anywhere, regardless of what the effect's own JSON asks for.
AllowFall-Comment: Globally allows or blocks any effect that grants fall damage protection, regardless of what the effect's own JSON asks for.
AllowRefresh-Comment: Globally allows or blocks re-applying (refreshing) an already-active effect for any effect that doesn't set its own replaceIfActive. An effect with replaceIfActive set always refreshes regardless of this setting.
AllowResize-Comment: Globally allows or blocks any effect that grows or shrinks a player, regardless of what the effect's own JSON asks for.
